items.title: iPhone users now won't have to wait as long for $250M settlement
items.summary: A court cut down how long Apple customers will have to wait to receive part of a $250 million settlement.

items.title: Apple Is Testing Its Fundamental Floor
items.summary: Apple just posted a monster quarter, yet the stock sits within striking distance of a support level that buyback math alone may not be enough to defend. Something has to break the standoff, and the next few weeks will reveal which side of the trade is right.

items.title: Apple Builds Custom AI Model for China With Alibaba
items.summary: Apple takes more control of its China AI push.

items.title: Apple Has a New Growth Engine, and It Could Be Huge
items.summary: Apple's Services segment just posted a record quarter while Siri AI prepares to reach 2.5 billion active devices, and the combination is forcing a serious reassessment of where this stock goes over the next 12 months.

items.title: Apple Is Sitting Out the AI Race—Except in China
items.summary: Apple has reportedly developed its own AI model for the Chinese market with support from its in-country partner, Alibaba Group.

items.title: Quantinuum Stock Could Get a Boost From Apple Partner Quanta Computer
items.summary: Just days after Quantinuum’s first earnings report as a public company, the quantum leader unveils a partnership with Taiwan’s Quanta Computer.

items.title: Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store
items.summary: Apple is asking a federal judge to allow it to charge commissions of up to 15% on purchases made through external links in iOS apps.

items.title: Apple trains China-specific AI model with Alibaba's help
items.summary: The move would make Apple the first foreign company approved by Beijing to offer a proprietary AI model in China
